fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: Date of report submission. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the restructured Loan

fields.name: ACCOUNT NUMBER/LOAN ID
fields.description: Loan account identifier number

fields.name: LOANS WRITTEN- OFF/RESTRUCTURED LOANS/NPLS RECOVERY FLAG
fields.description: A flag on whether the credit facility details being submitted are for a Write-Off, Restructure or the Recovery of Non- performing Loans
fields.payload_key: WRTN OFF RESTRD NPLS REC FLAG

fields.name: DESCRIPTION OF REASON FOR RESTRUCTURE
fields.description: As per CBK Prudential Guidelines

fields.name: DATE WHEN THE LOAN WAS RESTRUCTURED
fields.description: Date when the loan facility was restructured. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}
fields.payload_key: DATE WHEN THE LOAN WAS RESTRUCTURED

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: LOAN RESTRUCTURED AMOUNT IN CCY (OUTSTANDING)
fields.description: Loan Restructured Amount in the transacting currency (Outstanding)

fields.name: LOAN PERFORMANCE CLASSIFICATION
fields.description: Normal, watch, substandard, doubtful and loss classification as CBK's prudential guidelines.

fields.name: NATURE OF RESTRUCTURE
fields.description: Specific element that was modified. E.g. {Principal Loan Amount, Loan Tenure/Maturity, Interest Rate, Fees, Moratorium on Principal, Moratorium on Interest, Interest Rate Freeze, Freeze on fees, etc}.

fields.name: RESTRUCTURED MORE THAN ONCE FLAG (Y/N)
fields.description: Flag for the frequency of restructure {Y if the facility is restured more than once and N if the facility is only restructured once}

fields.name: NUMBER OF TIMES RESTRUCTURED
fields.description: Number of times that the credit facility has been retructured.

fields.name: LOAN WRITTEN-OFF OR WRITTEN-DOWN AMOUNT (PRINCIPAL)
fields.description: Loan amount written-down or written-off in local currency

fields.name: DESCRIPTION OF REASON FOR WRITE- OFF
fields.description: As per CBK Prudential Guidelines
fields.payload_key: DESCRIPTION OF REASON FOR WRITE- OFF

fields.name: DATE WHEN THE LOAN WAS WRITTEN- OFF/WRITTEN-DOWN
fields.description: Date of the transaction. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}
fields.payload_key: DATE WHEN THE LOAN WAS WRITTEN- OFF/WRITTEN-DOWN

fields.name: TOTAL EXPOSURE - PRINCIPAL
fields.description: Total Exposures as at reporting date – Principal in local currency

fields.name: TOTAL EXPOSURE - INTEREST
fields.description: Total Exposures as reporting date – Interest in local currency

fields.name: RECOVERY PRINCIPAL AMOUNT
fields.description: Recovered Amounts current month – Principal in local currency

fields.name: RECOVERY INTEREST AMOUNT
fields.description: Recovered Amounts current month – Interest in local currency

fields.name: DATE OF RECOVERY
fields.description: Last date of loan recovery or paid-off

fields.name: DELINQUENCY REASON
fields.description: Narration on the reason for defaulting

fields.name: RECOVERY ACTION
fields.description: Recovery action taken
